The clinical picture centers on a young woman with acute-onset severe anemia (Hb 7.5 g/dL), normocytic indices (MCV 89 fL), and marked reticulocytosis (13.3%) — indicating robust bone marrow response to *ongoing red blood cell loss or destruction*.
